hero.headline: Avalanche Team1 — Unified Leadership, Global Impact
hero.subhead: A central operational unit providing strategy, standards, and governance across regional teams worldwide.

whoWeAre.title: Who We Are
whoWeAre.content: Team1 serves as the central operational hub that coordinates and empowers regional teams across the Avalanche ecosystem. We provide strategic direction, establish governance frameworks, and deliver the tools and standards that enable regional teams to thrive. Through our unified leadership model, we ensure consistency, quality, and alignment across all Team1 initiatives globally.

roles.title: Global Lead
roles.description: Sets strategic vision and coordinates cross-regional alignment.
responsibilities: Ensure alignment across all regional teams
Manage stakeholder relationships with Avalanche Foundation

roles.title: Regional Leads
roles.description: Execute localized strategies while maintaining global standards.
responsibilities: Lead regional operations and team development
Adapt global strategy to local market needs
Report progress and insights to Global Lead

roles.title: Contributors & Core Teams
roles.description: Drive day-to-day execution and community engagement.
responsibilities: Execute programs and initiatives on the ground

capabilities.title: Core Responsibilities & Capabilities
items: Establish governance frameworks and operational standards
Develop and distribute tooling, templates, and resources
Provide training and enablement for regional teams
Coordinate cross-regional projects and knowledge sharing
Monitor performance metrics and drive continuous improvement
Foster alignment between regional initiatives and global goals

items.name: Alignment
items.description: We ensure all teams move in the same direction toward shared goals.

items.name: Accountability
items.description: We take ownership of our commitments and deliver results.

items.name: Respect
items.description: We value diverse perspectives and foster inclusive collaboration.

items.name: Craft
items.description: We pursue excellence in everything we build and deliver.

items.name: Transparency
items.description: We communicate openly and share knowledge freely.

milestones.description: Avalanche Team1 established as the central coordination body for global ecosystem growth.
Launched regional teams in Africa, Asia, and Latin America with standardized frameworks.
Implemented comprehensive governance model and performance tracking systems.
Coordinated 500+ events across 30+ countries, onboarding 10,000+ developers.
Expanding tooling, training, and cross-regional collaboration initiatives.

teamSnapshot.title: Meet the Team
teamSnapshot.intro: Our team is organized by region, with each member bringing unique expertise to advance the Avalanche ecosystem. Each card displays team members' roles, regions, and areas of focus, making it easy to connect with the right people for collaboration.
